item.title: Local Minister calls for more funding for road networks
item.description: A local TD has called for more funding for road networks. Sligo-Leitrim TD Frank Feighan told the Seanad the improvement and maintenance of the regional and local road network is the responsibility of each local authority. item.title: Local councillor keen to see what Ireland learns from Australian social media ban
item.description: A plan to follow in the steps of Australia and introduce a ban on social media for children could be in on the cards. Minister for Media Patrick O’Donovan is to brief cabinet with proposals to verify the age of children on social media as part of larger plans to set a digital age of consent. Australia will become the first country to impose a strict social media ban for children under the age of 16 from next week. item.title: Damien Kennedy affirmed as interim high performance head coach
item.description: Damien Kennedy has been confirmed as interim high performance head coach by the Irish Athletic Boxing Association. Hailing from Toome on the shores of Lough Neagh in County Antrim. Kennedy has three decades of coaching experience at all levels of the IABA. “It’s an honour to lead the National programme on an interim basis; to build on the legacy of boxing technical excellence learned from and with Zauri” said Kennedy. item.title: Department Approves €1.8m for 25 New Affordable Homes in Co. Longford
item.description: Over €1.8m has been approved by the Department of Housing for the construction of 25 new affordable homes in Co. Longford. The project is set to be carried out at Ard Michael on the Ballinalee Road in Longford Town. It's set to be the first time that Longford County Council will lead an affordable housing project. Advertisement Chief Executive of Longford County Council Paddy Mahon, said it's a major step forward for people in County Longford who want to own their own home.

item.title: Mohill FET Centre Poised for Major Upgrade Under New National Investment Plan
item.description: The Mohill FET Centre is set to become one of the standout success stories of the new national investment plan, with a transformative upgrade that will significantly expand training capacity in Leitrim. Enhanced workshops, digital learning suites, and modernised teaching spaces will position the centre as a premier hub for apprenticeships and lifelong learning. item.title: Sligo-Leitrim Senator Calls for Debate on Ending Child Poverty
item.description: A Sligo-Leitrim senator has called for debate on eradicating child poverty. Labour Party's Nessa Cosgrove argues that child poverty is the result of political choices, and says the €750 million of VAT for restaurant chains or increased defence spending could instead be directed toward measures like enhanced child benefit. item.title: Roberto Lopes SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers personality of the year
item.description: World Cup-bound Roberto ‘Pico’ Lopes of Shamrock Rovers and New York-born Kelly Brady scooped the annual SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers Ireland Personality of the Year awards at Friday’s gala ceremony in Dublin. Lopes, captained Rovers to the SSE Airtricity Men’s Premier Division and FAI Cup double for the first time since 1987, topped the ballot of football media.
